about_the_game: Rebel against the cops and the city, or choose good. Whatever you may choose in this world, you will grow and develop a variety of skills. You must forge your own path. Whether you decide to embrace chaos or uphold order, your decisions will shape your character and unlock unique opportunities. Build relationships, discover hidden areas, and uncover secrets in a world teeming with choices. The freedom to decide is yours, and every action paves the way for new adventures and challenges ahead.

content_descriptors.notes: Mature content pertains to some drug use and references as well as slight gore throughout.

short_description: Grit & Grind is a retro arcade style RPG where you strive to make a difference amid a fast-paced world. Fight the Mob, shop at the grocery, chop trees or mine rocks, complete freedom! Navigate complex challenges, or build connections, and redefine what it means to thrive with purpose and impact.
